capabilities: Open a date's section in the master note from a sidebar calendar
Create missing dated sections in newest-first chronological order
Show which dates have entries and which contain unfinished tasks
Reorder dated sections with a timeline-repair command
Configure the master note, journal heading, and new-date template
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes file creator; it never makes one file per day and keeps every entry as a section in a single master note.
extras: Community directory submission is pending, so installation is manual from GitHub releases until approved. Settings and command names are shown in Chinese with English glosses, and the README includes a Chinese summary. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; works on desktop and mobile with no external dependencies.
motivation: The author built it for people who keep a continuous journal instead of creating a separate daily note for every date.
problem: Obsidian's daily-notes workflow creates a separate file for every date, but people who keep a continuous journal in a single note have no calendar to jump to or create dated sections in it.
summary: Sidebar calendar that opens, creates, and tracks dated sections inside one continuous-journal Markdown note instead of one file per day.
